question: Can the already-audited parameterized mechanism carrier (git blob b15ed8487e2d1326df4ca64fb4c7b6e5a0ebf796, sha256 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72) be installed byte-identically at the shipping kernel path src/spider/kernel.py and made to pass the already-frozen, already-audited deterministic-fixture promotion certificate ARM-DIFFERENTIATION-CERTIFICATE-v1 (EXP-PRODUCT-37950607128) through the public shipped package `import spider` - (a) POSITIVE: distill_parameterized over the fixture's 4 (=>=3) same-intent induction observations yields a mechanism whose resolve() is EXECUTABLE with a correctly bound non-null action at confidence 0.9 on the UNSEEN held-out identifiers (itm-0009, epsilon, tok-99, res-z, tenant t9/item_id i9, n-09), whose deterministic fixture execution returns HTTP-equivalent status 200, and whose verify() returns true; (b) NEGATIVE: out-of-support and missing-parameter bindings are refused with a recorded reason and a null bound action, and wrong-intent bindings return exactly ResolutionStatus.UNKNOWN (the no-applicable-mechanism case) with a null bound action; (c) COUNTERS: the certificate calls resolve exactly once and verify exactly once per positive execution with no fallback/rebind (so the inherited-path per-execution increments are retrieval_calls=1, verification_calls=1, repair_attempts=0) and its accounting-fidelity check reports exactly retrieval_calls=3/verification_calls=2/repair_attempts=1 over the frozen resolve/verify/refuse/rebind/verify/resolve sequence with model_calls=model_tokens=0 throughout; (d) IDENTITY: the installed file sha256 equals 718efa6a... and `git hash-object src/spider/kernel.py` equals b15ed848... - with the pre-install shipped kernel (blob cfec98660b0277ccbf295e8a4119e8d81ddccf50) unable to execute the same certificate at all, so that promotion is enabled ONLY on independent audit PASS, discharging blocker B1?
hypothesis: The byte-identical install is consumed by the shipped `spider` package and passes every frozen promotion-certificate check (PROMOTION_READY). The fixture certificate itself was already established and independently audited PASS on an in-place install of this exact carrier (EXP-PRODUCT-37950607128: certificate_overall=PASS, AD-POSITIVE 6/6, AD-NEGATIVE 24/24, counter fidelity exact, audit status=PASS), and the current shipped kernel has since been reverted to blob cfec9866, so the new object of study is not the mechanism but the durable identity-bound install plus a v2-hash-bound certificate: the carrier bytes, the reused certificate driver, the fixture, the unchanged modules and the regression test are all pinned by sha256 in freeze.json, the pre-install kernel is required to fail the same certificate, and the install identity is asserted before and after measurement.
falsifier: Any single frozen promotion-certificate check fails: (PC1) the recorded pre-install kernel is not blob cfec9866 / sha256 46929b3a..., or the installed file sha256 != 718efa6a... / git blob != b15ed848... / != the frozen artifact hash; (PC2) the frozen ARM-DIFFERENTIATION-CERTIFICATE-v1 does not return certificate_overall=PASS with all six sub-checks pass=true; (PC3) any held-out case is not EXECUTABLE, lacks a non-null correctly bound action, does not execute with status 200, does not verify true, or carries an empty inferred_slots list (which would make the 0.9 confidence entailment inapplicable); (PC4) any out-of-support / missing-parameter case is not refused with a recorded reason and null bound action, or any wrong-intent case is not exactly ResolutionStatus.UNKNOWN; (PC5) the accounting-fidelity inherited-path increments differ from retrieval_calls=3/verification_calls=2/repair_attempts=1, or the positive path performs anything other than one resolve and one verify per case (no rebind/fallback), or model_calls/model_tokens are non-zero; (PC6) the pre-install kernel can execute the certificate (it must ImportError, first on TrajectoryCounters/_support_accepts), the pre-install source contains any distill_parameterized occurrence, the literal path reaches EXECUTABLE on a held-out case, or the treatment action equals the retrieval-shaped comparator; (PC7) tests/test_kernel.py fails after install. A PC3/PC4 failure would show the shipped package cannot consume the carrier; a PC6 failure would show the positive is not sensitive to the parameterized path.
baselines: B-PREINSTALL-KERNEL: the shipped pre-install kernel src/spider/kernel.py at base_sha 15c00119031eb27d658101de411e33413585b308 and HEAD (git blob cfec9866, sha256 46929b3a...) contains zero occurrences of `distill_parameterized`, `_support_accepts`, `TrajectoryCounters` and `rebind` (verified: `git show HEAD:src/spider/kernel.py`), so the reused certificate driver cannot even import against it (ImportError); its only induction path is the literal `distill`, which emits confidence 0.5 below the 0.8 resolve threshold. Inherited empirical anchor: EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440 B-LITERAL-KERNEL returned EXPLORE on 200/200 held-out tasks (success_rate 0.0).

B-LITERAL-KERNEL (in-certificate null/ablation): a fresh registry populated only via the installed kernel's preserved literal distill() over the fixture induction observations must reach zero EXECUTABLE resolutions on the held-out cases (literal confidence 0.5 < min_confidence 0.8).

B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED (in-certificate comparator): the structural-similarity literal-retrieval comparator over the induction observations must differ from the treatment's bound action (AD-TREATMENT-CONTRAST contrast_rate > 0), and a degenerate treatment equal to the comparator must be detected.

B-AUDITED-CERT-ANCHOR: the same frozen certificate returned certificate_overall=PASS on an in-place install of this identical carrier in EXP-PRODUCT-37950607128 (result.json status=COMPLETE outcome=SUPPORTS; audit.json status=PASS; kernel_identity post blob b15ed848 / sha256 718efa6a). This is the inherited satisfiability anchor for the positive branch; disagreement between it and this experiment is a validity threat to report, not a re-measurement.
positive_control: PC-AD-POSITIVE-ROUNDTRIP (frozen, in-certificate): the reused ARM-DIFFERENTIATION-CERTIFICATE-v1 AD-POSITIVE-ROUNDTRIP check must pass 6/6 held-out in-support identifiers on the deterministic fixture with in_support_executable_rate == 1.0 and held_out_binding_correct_rate == 1.0. Inherited anchor: the identical check passed 6/6 with audit PASS in EXP-PRODUCT-37950607128. A positive control that cannot fire invalidates the certificate; it is expected at the 1.0 ceiling and its ceiling status is disclosed, not hidden.
null_control: Three nulls make the positive branch's dependence on the parameterized path falsifiable: (i) N-LITERAL-PATH = the in-certificate B-LITERAL-KERNEL check (literal confidence 0.5) must yield zero EXECUTABLE resolutions on the held-out cases; (ii) N-NO-APPLICABLE = the in-certificate wrong_intent cases must return exactly ResolutionStatus.UNKNOWN with a null bound action and reason 'no applicable validated mechanism'; (iii) N-PREINSTALL-IMPORT = running the byte-identical certificate driver against the recorded pre-install kernel (blob cfec9866) must exit non-zero with ImportError. All three are expected at the floor (0/absent); if any null fires as positive, PC4/PC6 fail.
measurement_validity: Instrument reuse is explicit and bounded: the promotion certificate is the already-frozen, already-audited deterministic-fixture certificate ARM-DIFFERENTIATION-CERTIFICATE-v1 of EXP-PRODUCT-37950607128 (driver sha256 59895ddd9a85b6b3f75f9bfef6d39c423740679517df24505d26965918525970, fixture sha256 b0ffcbba5041871f58408c4766268b31bb84cb81ccef965cd944c486fd4dd6cf). EXECUTE byte-copies these two frozen files into research/experiments/EXP-PRODUCT-38125439288/harness/ and asserts sha256(copy)==frozen artifact hash before executing, so the copy carries no independent degrees of freedom; the original experiment's raw evidence is never overwritten.

Public-package import: the certificate driver inserts <repo>/src on sys.path and imports `spider.kernel`, `spider.models`, `spider.registry` from the shipped package (not the parent's vendored `audited_spider`); the regression suite imports `from spider import ...`. The certificate therefore measures the shipped package and not a research copy.

Treatment binding: the treatment bytes are the frozen carrier research/experiments/EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440/harness/audited_spider/kernel.py (sha256 718efa6a..., git blob b15ed848...); the untouched shipped modules src/spider/models.py and src/spider/registry.py are byte-identical to the carrier's vendored copies (sha256 338aaf4d... and 51fb440d...), so the install is a single-file drop-in and no second module is reinterpreted.

Confidence 0.9 is an entailment, not an independent measurement: the carrier's resolve() returns EXECUTABLE only when the chosen mechanism's confidence is >= min_confidence (default 0.8); distill_parameterized assigns confidence exactly 0.9 when its parameterized postconditions re-verify on every induction observation and 0.5 otherwise; the literal distill path assigns 0.5. The certificate records inferred_slot_count >= 1 for each positive case (parameterized mechanism), so any EXECUTABLE positive case has confidence exactly 0.9. This arithmetic lives entirely in the frozen carrier bytes bound by PC1; because the certificate JSON does not emit a confidence field, AUDIT must read the PC1-bound carrier to re-derive 0.9, and the entailment is valid only while PC1 holds.

Unseen-identifier regime is declared and bounded: the held-out identifiers (itm-0009, epsilon, tok-99, res-z, t9/i9, n-09) are disjoint from the induction identifiers (itm-0001..0004, alpha..delta, tok-11..44, res-a..d, t1..i1..t4/i4, n-01..04), but they lie INSIDE the support grammar the carrier induces from those induction values (e.g. ^itm-000[0-9]{1}$, ^[a-z]+$, ^tok-[0-9]{2}$, ^res-[a-z]$, ^t[0-9]{1}$/^i[0-9]{1}$, ^n-0[0-9]{1}$). This certificate therefore establishes integration identity + unseen in-support identifier binding, NOT free-form support generalization; that boundary is carried forward from the parent handoff's do_not_assume and is not re-opened.

Determinism and credential-freedom: fixture.SEED = 37950607128; observations, held-out values and executor responses are pure functions of the frozen fixture (stdlib only: re, json, hashlib, subprocess, tempfile). There is no network, no model endpoint, no browser, no credential, and no wall-clock input. model_calls=model_tokens=0 by construction because no model is invoked, and this is labeled as by-construction, not as a measured zero.

Counter honesty: the certificate's PC-ACCOUNTING-FIDELITY separates a seeded scripted trajectory (explicitly labeled injected) from the inherited-path increments observed on a real resolve/verify/rebind/refuse sequence; only the latter is used for PC5. latency_ms/1000 is excluded from every check, because the parent packet showed latency-inclusive metrics were non-discriminating.

Environment determinism: the certificate is stdlib-only and its support-inference arithmetic depends on the recorded Python 3.12 semantics (re.escape over the induced literal prefix). EXECUTE records the interpreter version, the fixture seed and the exact file hashes; a different Python major/minor that changed those semantics would be a measurement-environment change and must be recorded as such, not silently accepted.

Blinding/ordering: the pre-install kernel blob and sha256 are recorded before the install; the pre-install certificate import failure is captured before the install; the install precedes all positive measurement; identity and the certificate are re-evaluated after measurement; the certificate outcome is computed by the frozen checks, never selected after seeing results.

Governance residual: scripts/freeze_experiment.py binds freeze_artifacts by sha256 but does not itself execute the certificate; the certificate is therefore made binding by being the frozen decision rule PC2/PC3/PC4/PC5/PC6 of this packet and by the independent AUDIT requirement, and this residual is disclosed in the report rather than claimed as automatic enforcement.
decision_rule: The frozen promotion certificate PROMOTION-CERTIFICATE-B1-v2 is the conjunction of seven stable checks, each PASS/FAIL, each evaluated independently (no short-circuit, so a failing dimension is always localized). Every check is computed ONLY from (i) shell/hash commands over bound files, (ii) the JSON outputs of the reused frozen certificate driver, and (iii) the exit code of the existing unit-test module; no post-freeze-authored interpretation code may alter any threshold or expected value. PC1-INSTALL-IDENTITY: recorded pre-install `git hash-object src/spider/kernel.py` == cfec98660b0277ccbf295e8a4119e8d81ddccf50, `sha256` == 46929b3a951df48d7f9d1fd850871073c0d91c1868aa117e13d389fe274e8d61, `git rev-parse HEAD:src/spider/kernel.py` == cfec9866; after byte-copy, `sha256(src/spider/kernel.py)` == 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72 AND `git hash-object` == b15ed8487e2d1326df4ca64fb4c7b6e5a0ebf796 AND equals freeze.json.artifact_hashes[carrier path]; re-asserted after measurement. PC2-FIXTURE-CERTIFICATE: reused ARM-DIFFERENTIATION-CERTIFICATE-v1 reports certificate_overall == 'PASS' and each of AD-POSITIVE-ROUNDTRIP, AD-NEGATIVE-ROUNDTRIP, AD-TREATMENT-CONTRAST, PC-ACCOUNTING-FIDELITY, AD-IDENTITY-BINDING, B-LITERAL-KERNEL has pass == true. PC3-UNSEEN-IDENTIFIER-BINDING: AD-POSITIVE-ROUNDTRIP.n_pass == n_cases == 6 and every case has resolution_status == 'EXECUTABLE', bound_action != null, binding_correct == true, execution_status_200 == true, verify_true == true, slot_count_match == true, inferred_slot_count >= 1; in_support_executable_rate == 1.0 and held_out_binding_correct_rate == 1.0; with confidence 0.9 entailed per measurement_validity[3]. PC4-NEGATIVE-TAXONOMY: AD-NEGATIVE-ROUNDTRIP.refusal_rate == 1.0, out_of_support_refusal_rate == 1.0, missing_param_refusal_rate == 1.0, wrong_intent_refusal_rate == 1.0; every case with kind startswith 'out_of_support' or == 'missing_param' has resolution_status != 'EXECUTABLE', bound_action == null and a non-empty reason; every kind == 'wrong_intent' case has resolution_status == 'UNKNOWN', bound_action == null and a non-empty reason (the no-applicable-mechanism case). PC5-COUNTER-HONESTY: PC-ACCOUNTING-FIDELITY.pass == true; inherited_path_counter_increments.pass == true with observed == {'retrieval_calls':3,'verification_calls':2,'repair_attempts':1} over the frozen resolve/verify/refuse/rebind/verify/resolve exercise sequence; model_counters.model_calls == 0 and model_tokens == 0; the certificate calls resolve exactly once and verify exactly once per positive case with no rebind/fallback, so the per-positive-execution inherited-path increments are retrieval_calls=1, verification_calls=1, repair_attempts=0 (established from the PC1-bound driver semantics, since the positive-roundtrip kernel has counters=None); the injected scripted trajectory is excluded from the honest-counter claim. PC6-ABLATION-SENSITIVITY: the byte-identical certificate driver run against recorded pre-install bytes (cfec9866) exits non-zero with ImportError; `git show <pre_execute_sha>:src/spider/kernel.py | grep -c distill_parameterized` == 0; B-LITERAL-KERNEL.pass == true; AD-TREATMENT-CONTRAST.pass == true (contrast_rate > 0 and degenerate variant detected). PC7-UNIT-REGRESSION: `PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest tests.test_kernel -v` exits 0 on all tests with the installed kernel. Decision: PROMOTION_READY if and only if PC1..PC7 all PASS, and then certificate_overall = PASS; otherwise NOT_PROMOTION_READY with certificate_overall = FAIL and every failing check plus its raw evidence recorded. Promotion (promote_to_product=true and any C-PARAM-INHERIT status advance) is not self-authorized here: it is enabled only by an independent AUDIT PASS of this packet.
product_consequence_positive: If PROMOTION_READY and the independent audit returns PASS, the Director may set promote_to_product=true and advance C-PARAM-INHERIT (EXPERIMENTAL) toward PRODUCT_CORE; the shipped `spider` package then exposes distill/resolve parameterized inheritance to external agents, blocker B1 is discharged, and the C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY / C-PRODUCT-ECON experiments become constructible on a live shipped carrier with a byte-pinned identity. The claim ceiling remains: unseen in-support identifier binding on the deterministic credential-free REST class with model_calls=0 by construction - a capability/promotion result, not a cost-reduction result.
product_consequence_negative: If NOT_PROMOTION_READY (or the audit does not PASS), no promotion occurs: promote_to_product stays false, C-PARAM-INHERIT stays EXPERIMENTAL, blocker B1 remains open, and src/spider/kernel.py is reverted to the recorded pre-execute bytes (blob cfec9866). The exact failing check(s) and raw evidence are recorded so the next mandate targets the precise integration defect instead of re-running any economics certificate. The criteria are not weakened after outcomes are seen.
estimated_cost: One local CPU run of a small deterministic stdlib-only certificate harness over a synthetic 6-family fixture (6 induction groups of 4 observations, 6 held-out cases, 24 negative resolves), one pre-install import-failure run, and one 3-test unit suite. No model calls, no tokens, no browser, no network, no credentials. Order of a second to a few seconds of local compute; zero external cost.
expected_information_gain: This isolates the single remaining unproven link on the product-critical path: whether the frozen, audited carrier can be installed byte-identically at the shipping path and consumed through the public `spider` package under a v2 hash binding, with the pre-install kernel demonstrably failing the same certificate. A PASS converts an audited mechanism into a promotion-ready shipped capability (B1 discharged) and unblocks the C-LLM-INHERIT / residual-novelty economics thread; a FAIL localizes the exact identity or integration defect. Either result is decisive for the B1 promotion decision, which the excluded dynamic-range economics certificate cannot be.

decision_rule_reachability.reason: Both branches are reachable and the positive branch has an inherited empirical anchor at the ceiling. Positive: the identical frozen certificate returned certificate_overall=PASS on an in-place install of this exact carrier in EXP-PRODUCT-37950607128 (AD-POSITIVE 6/6, AD-NEGATIVE 24/24, counters exact, audit PASS), and a code trace of the bound carrier confirms each fixture family yields a non-empty slot set and a 0.9-confidence self-verified mechanism. Negative: NOT_PROMOTION_READY is reachable via a wrong install hash (PC1), a non-PASS certificate (PC2), any held-out binding failure (PC3), any taxonomy failure including a wrong-intent case not exactly UNKNOWN (PC4), counter drift (PC5), the pre-install kernel actually running the certificate or the literal path reaching EXECUTABLE (PC6), or a unit-test regression (PC7). No check is vacuous: PC6 requires the pre-install/literal variants to fail, so an insensitive positive is detectable, and checks are evaluated independently rather than short-circuited.
